name: Clean the Bay
storyline: After an oil rig, a pipeline and a tanker sank in the same stormy night, the bay is covered in oil and the tycoon Sterling Sheen has vanished. Grandma Greta calls her grandchild home and reopens the old coast guard station. Letters in bottles signed "L." hint at what really happened and lead to five leaks that still need to be sealed.
summary: Clean the Bay is a cozy cleaning and management simulation. After an oil disaster caused by the tycoon Sterling Sheen, the player returns to their home bay and cleans the polluted water field by field, starting with a kayak and a sponge. Collected oil is sold to buy better tools, boats and upgrades, from cloths and mops to skimmers and a coast guard boat. Cleaned areas recover as fish, kelp and corals return, and 36 animal species can be photographed for a logbook. Oil barrels have to be recovered before they leak, and storms push new oil to the coast. Messages in bottles signed "L." tell the story behind the disaster. The game can be played solo or in online co-op for up to four players.
